population: Inspected synthetic DEV: fifteen configured conversation branches from the actual knowledge_eval.py synthetic_dev archives; not the separate sixteen-case candidate-validator DEV corpus; not blind holdout.

generic_rubric.invariant: Every draft and semantic review judgement uses supplied observations and exact UTF-8 occurrence spans. Preserve source speakers, pointers and branches; same quote text at another offset is another occurrence. No prior identities, code execution, hidden branch or world fact is imported.

Differentiate assertions of source speech from questions, suggestions, plans, uncertainty and hypotheticals. A quote grounds the asserted reporting event and its quoted content without certifying content truth. Source-supported completion claims remain attributed reports.

Reported/quoted propositions retain quoted scope; quoted labels, titles and code examples are not automatically propositions asserted by the speaker. Multiple scoped analyses are allowed if they preserve this distinction.

Negation has the correct local body; conjunction preserves each member without substituting for disjunction, timing or choice. A conditional must preserve its stated direction and whether it expresses a sufficient cause, necessary gate, or procedural permission; the surface event-to-prerequisite reading is valid for a necessary condition. Operand order alone does not encode event time.

Preserve sequence, version labels, old/new direction and pending/rejected/retained alternatives. Changes, reversals and corrections are not automatically logical negations of historical propositions. Locate temporal/alternative meanings beyond the five native operations. Source-grounded predicate applications may preserve temporal/comparison/alternative content atomically; require located partial/unknown only where that interpretation loses required structure, and never claim that an atomic label proves structural sequence accuracy.

A quantifier needs a source-grounded domain and binding; preserve binder identity, references and nearest-scope shadowing if present. This sample contains no explicit symbolic-variable or shadowing test; do not claim measured binder/shadowing quality from native validity.

Unsupported questions, modality, sequence, comparison, alternatives and contradiction must retain exact located partial/unsupported/ambiguous/unknown records rather than wildcard operands or an unlocated omission. Full abstention and unavailable output remain unresolved, not successful extraction.
